nodes.speaker: Elder Maren
nodes.text: Welcome to Brookhollow, traveller. These are troubled times. Goblins raid our fields, and something stirs in the old ruins.

options.text: Can I help with the goblins?

nodes.speaker: Elder Maren
nodes.text: Bless you. Drive off five goblins at the edge of Greenleaf Forest and bring me three of their crude charms as proof.

nodes.speaker: Elder Maren
nodes.text: Three charms! The fields will be safe for a while. Take this for your trouble.

nodes.speaker: Elder Maren
nodes.text: Embervale was once lit by the great Hearthstones. When they dimmed, the old kingdom fell to ruin. Highmarch to the north is all that remains of its glory.

nodes.speaker: Hollin the Smith
nodes.text: Need steel? Or need to learn to make your own?

nodes.speaker: Hollin the Smith
nodes.text: Mine copper and tin in the quarry east of the village, smelt a bronze bar at my furnace, then hammer a dagger on the anvil. Bring it here.

nodes.speaker: Hollin the Smith
nodes.text: Not bad for a first try! Keep it, and take a few bars to practise.

nodes.speaker: Tilda
nodes.text: Supplies for every adventurer! Take a look.

nodes.speaker: Banker
nodes.text: Good day. How may the Hearthvault serve you?

options.text: I'd like to access my vault.

nodes.speaker: Exchange Clerk
nodes.text: Welcome to the Embervale Exchange. Post an offer and we'll match it with other adventurers, even while you're away.

options.text: I'd like to trade on the Exchange.

nodes.speaker: Exchange Clerk
nodes.text: Buy offers hold your coins, sell offers hold your goods. Trades happen at the older offer's price, any overpayment is refunded, and the Exchange keeps one coin in every hundred from sales.

nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.text: Keep out of trouble. The roads past the forest aren't safe after dark.

nodes.speaker: Villager
nodes.text: Lovely weather today, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Bram the Innkeeper
nodes.text: Warm stew and a soft bed. Folk say a lost map of the forest is held by the goblins.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Innkeeper
nodes.text: My grandmother's map shows a hidden grove deep in Greenleaf. Find the scrap and visit the grove for me.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Innkeeper
nodes.text: So the grove is real! Here, take these for your trouble.

nodes.speaker: Seeker Ilsa
nodes.text: The Hollow Warden guards the deepest vault of the Ancient Ruins. Defeat it and the Hearthstone shard is yours.

nodes.speaker: Seeker Ilsa
nodes.text: Incredible. Embervale owes you a debt.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Fisher
nodes.text: Fish are biting by the lake. Catch me five perch and cook them, would you?

nodes.speaker: Odo the Fisher
nodes.text: Delicious! Here's a harpoon voucher... well, some coins anyway.

nodes.speaker: Archivist Sel
nodes.text: Runes, staves and robes. Mind the sparks.

nodes.speaker: Quartermaster Dane
nodes.text: Highmarch steel. The best in the realm.

nodes.speaker: Wenna Mossbottle
nodes.text: Herbs, seeds and remedies!
